title: Authenticated user can load the Dashboard from the root route
description: Verifies a logged-in user can reach the main Dashboard view from the root route.

title: Dashboard shows key operational sections after login
description: Verifies the Dashboard view renders core overview sections (projects, tasks, clients, and financial indicators).

title: Dashboard handles slow loading state gracefully
description: Verifies a loading indicator (or loading text) is shown while the Dashboard metrics are being fetched.

steps.description: Verify element "Dashboard loading indicator" is visible
Wait for the Dashboard content to finish loading
Verify element "Dashboard loading indicator" is not visible

title: View projects list after login
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access the projects list and see the list UI load.

title: Open a project details page from the projects list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open a specific project's details from the list and see the details page.

steps.description: Click on the first visible project in the projects list

title: Project details page shows key information sections
description: Verifies the project details view renders primary information sections for an existing project.

steps.description: Click on the first visible project in the projects list

title: Projects list displays at least one project row/item
description: Verifies the projects list shows at least one visible project item (when data exists) and the list container renders.

title: Projects list remains usable after returning from a project details page
description: Verifies navigation back to the projects list via in-app UI works and the list is visible again.

steps.description: Click on the first visible project in the projects list
Click the "Back" or "Voltar" button/link on the project details page

title: Project details view shows a clear empty/missing-state when fields are not available
description: Verifies the project details page displays a visible placeholder or label when optional fields (e.g., due date/value) are absent.

steps.description: Click on a project in the projects list that appears to have missing optional information (e.g., blank due date/value)

title: View tasks board after login
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access the Tasks page and see the kanban/list UI.

title: Create a new task with valid title and default status
description: Verifies a user can add a new task and see it appear in the task list/board.

steps.description: Type "E2E Task - Create" into the task title field

title: Newly created task is visible in the tasks view
description: Verifies that after creating a task, the task card/row is visible on the Tasks page.

steps.description: Type "E2E Task - Visible" into the task title field
Verify text "E2E Task - Visible" is visible

title: Move a task to In Progress using status control
description: Verifies a task status can be updated to In Progress and the UI reflects the change.

steps.description: Type "E2E Task - To In Progress" into the task title field
Click on task "E2E Task - To In Progress"
Select "In Progress" from the status dropdown

title: Attempt to create a task with empty title shows validation error
description: Verifies the UI prevents saving a task without a title and shows a visible error message.

steps.description: Verify text "Title is required" is visible

title: Cancel task creation closes dialog and does not add task
description: Verifies canceling out of the new-task flow returns to the tasks page without showing the task.

steps.description: Type "E2E Task - Should Not Save" into the task title field
Verify text "E2E Task - Should Not Save" is not visible

title: Invalid status value is blocked by UI controls
description: Verifies the UI does not allow selecting an invalid status (prevents invalid PATCH) by restricting status options.

steps.description: Type "E2E Task - Status Options" into the task title field
Click on task "E2E Task - Status Options"

title: View Financial dashboard after logging in
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access the financial dashboard page and see core dashboard sections.

title: Create a revenue transaction from the Financial dashboard
description: Verifies a user can add a revenue transaction and see it reflected in the transactions list.

title: Create an expense transaction from the Financial dashboard
description: Verifies a user can add an expense transaction and see it reflected in the transactions list.

title: Validate that negative expense amount is rejected in the UI
description: Verifies the UI prevents saving an expense transaction with a negative amount and shows a validation message.

title: Dashboard remains unchanged after failed expense submission
description: Verifies that after a failed attempt to add an invalid expense, the transactions list does not show the invalid entry.

title: Generate a financial report for a date range
description: Verifies the user can generate a report for a selected date range and see report results rendered.

steps.description: Type "2026-03-01" into the From date field
Type "2026-03-06" into the To date field

title: Report validation when 'From' date is after 'To' date
description: Verifies the report form shows a visible validation message and does not generate results for an invalid date range.

steps.description: Type "2026-03-10" into the From date field
Type "2026-03-01" into the To date field

title: Cancel adding a transaction does not create a new entry
description: Verifies dismissing the add-transaction flow leaves the dashboard without a newly created transaction row.

title: Create a new inbox item from the Inbox page (happy path)
description: Verifies a user can add a new inbox item with a title, content, and source and see it in the inbox list.

steps.description: Type "New lead idea" into the "Title" field
Type "Client asked about a landing page refresh; capture requirements." into the "Content" field
Verify text "New lead idea" is visible

title: Convert an existing inbox item into a task (happy path)
description: Verifies a user can convert an inbox item into a task by selecting a project and assignee and then sees a success confirmation.

steps.description: Verify text "Caixa de Entrada" is visible
Click on the first inbox item in the list
Verify element "Convert to task" is visible
Select the first available option from the "Project" dropdown
Select the first available option from the "Assignee" dropdown

title: Create inbox item with empty content shows validation error
description: Verifies the form blocks submission when content is empty and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Verify text "Caixa de Entrada" is visible
Type "Item without content" into the "Title" field

title: Validation error clears after entering required content and resubmitting
description: Verifies that after a required-field error, entering content and resubmitting succeeds and the error is no longer shown.

steps.description: Type "Now the content is provided." into the "Content" field

title: Cancel convert-to-task keeps inbox item unchanged
description: Verifies that cancelling the convert-to-task flow does not create a task and returns the user to the inbox item view.

steps.description: Click on the first inbox item in the list
Verify text "Convert to task" is visible
Verify element "Create task" is not visible

title: Convert-to-task requires selecting a project
description: Verifies the convert-to-task form shows a visible error when attempting to create a task without selecting a project.

steps.description: Click on the first inbox item in the list
Select the first available option from the "Assignee" dropdown

title: Convert-to-task requires selecting an assignee
description: Verifies the convert-to-task form shows a visible error when attempting to create a task without selecting an assignee.

steps.description: Click on the first inbox item in the list
Select the first available option from the "Project" dropdown

title: View client directory list
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open the Clients page and see the client list.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation

title: Open a client profile from the directory
description: Verifies an authenticated user can open a client profile and see summary information.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation
Click on the first client in the list

title: Create a new client from Clients page
description: Verifies an authenticated user can add a new client and see it appear in the directory.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation
Type "Test Client A" into the "Name" field
Type "Test Company A" into the "Company" field
Verify text "Test Client A" is visible

title: Cancel client creation without saving
description: Verifies a user can open the new client form and cancel without adding a client.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation

title: Validation: required fields on new client form
description: Verifies the new client form blocks submission when required fields are missing and shows a visible validation message.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation

title: Duplicate client creation shows conflict error
description: Verifies attempting to create a client with a duplicate unique identifier shows a visible conflict/error message and does not create a duplicate entry.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation

title: Client profile shows projects summary section
description: Verifies the client profile page displays a projects summary section for a selected client.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation
Click on the first client in the list

title: Client directory refreshes and remains usable after error dismissal
description: Verifies the Clients page remains functional after dismissing an error and the list is still visible.

steps.description: Click on "Clients" in the main navigation

title: View Settings page after login
description: Verifies an authenticated user can access the Settings page and sees core settings sections.

steps.description: Verify the Settings page heading text "Configurações" is visible

title: Reject invalid email format and keep previous value
description: Verifies entering an invalid email shows a validation error and does not overwrite the previously saved email.

steps.description: Verify text "Invalid email" / "E-mail inválido" is visible

title: Cancel edits does not persist changes
description: Verifies using a cancel/reset action discards unsaved changes on the Settings page.

steps.description: Type "Temp Company Name" into the Company Name / "Nome da empresa" field
Verify text "Temp Company Name" is not visible
